purpose: three alternatives for user style selection, not in-game assets
source_plan: docs/计划/2026-10-29_城堡场景风格概念图提示词.md

styles.name: 经典恶魔城
styles.text: Classic 16-bit era Castlevania: Symphony of the Night inspired. Rich hand-drawn stone textures with clear brick shading, gothic ornament, deep purples and blues, painterly but strictly pixel art.
styles.prompt:
Create a mock-up in-game screenshot for a 2D side-scrolling pixel art Metroidvania (Castlevania-like), set INSIDE a dark castle.

Technical format:
- Exactly 16:9, designed at a native resolution of 640x360 pixels and scaled up 2x with nearest-neighbor (1280x720 output). One consistent square pixel grid, crisp pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients smoothing, no photographic lighting.
- Strict side view (orthographic, like a classic 2D platformer). No perspective vanishing points, no isometric angle.

Main character (use the attached image as the exact design): Niu Lai, a small chubby yellow calf with a big round hornless head, cream muzzle, one thick dark eyebrow, pink inner ear, brown shorts and belt, short tail, holding a large plain steel-gray greatsword. He stands on the floor in the left third of the frame, facing right, about 64 native pixels tall (about 1/5.5 of the screen height). Keep his colors and proportions exactly; he must be the most readable thing on screen.

Scene composition (layers, back to front):
1. Far background: tall castle hall wall with gothic arched windows showing a deep night sky and a pale moon, hanging red banners, chains, wall torches with warm flickering light.
2. Mid background: a row of stone columns / arches, slightly darker, giving depth.
3. Gameplay layer: a solid stone floor across the bottom ~60 native px of the screen, one raised stone step, and two thin one-way wooden platforms floating at different heights. The walkable surfaces must clearly read as solid and different from the background (stronger contrast, clear top edge).
4. A few foreground silhouette elements at the very edges (a dark pillar or hanging chain) to add depth, not covering the character.
- Add one simple enemy on the right side for scale (a small goblin-like demon, about the same height as Niu Lai).
- A minimal HUD: a row of small red health pips at the top left.

Color and light: limited palette (about 24-32 colors). Background desaturated and darker, cool tones; torchlight warm orange; gameplay surfaces medium contrast; the yellow calf pops against the background. Light comes from the upper left.

Mood: a birthday-gift game, slightly goofy but adventurous. Dark castle, not horror.

Style direction: Classic 16-bit era Castlevania: Symphony of the Night inspired. Rich hand-drawn stone textures with clear brick shading, gothic ornament, deep purples and blues, painterly but strictly pixel art.

Input roles: Image 1 is the approved Niu Lai character identity reference; preserve its face, hornless yellow round head, thick near eyebrow, cream muzzle, ears, shorts, belt, tail and plain greatsword. Image 2 is ONLY a loose layout/context reference: it is a four-panel contact sheet of the current prototype. Output ONE continuous full-screen game view, never a contact sheet, split panels, captions or a copied debug screenshot. Replace its modular low-poly look with the requested hand-crafted pixel style. No debug text or keybinding text. Do not copy lettering or hit counters from Image 2.
Controlled comparison layout, measured in native 640x360 coordinates: flat ground top at y300, solid floor down to y360. Niu Lai centered near x160, feet at y300, body height64 (greatsword may extend above him), fully visible and facing right. One modest raised stone step on right, roughly x500-610 with top at y264. Exactly two thin floating wooden one-way platforms: one near x270-365 at y210, one near x400-475 at y150. One small goofy green goblin demon near x550 on the step, body about60 pixels high. Keep floor edges and platform tops straight, unobstructed, high-contrast and easy to read. Gothic windows show night sky through the far wall; pale moon in a window, red banners and torches placed logically. Columns stay behind the play area; foreground silhouettes restricted to extreme edges. The hero must be readable at gameplay scale, not a giant foreground character. One short row of red health pips at upper left, no written HUD text. Design each stone, ornament, torch and platform coherently. Pixel-scale palette steps for every glow and haze; never gaussian blur or painted smooth gradients. Landscape composition exactly 16:9, intended output 1280x720, 2x pixel grid from640x360. No visible pixel grid lines or added borders. This is a concept game screenshot, not a promotional illustration.

styles.name: 现代精致像素
styles.text: Modern high-detail pixel art like Dead Cells / Blasphemous backgrounds: atmospheric depth haze between layers, rim light, dramatic warm-vs-cool contrast, but still crisp pixels.
